limitations: The observation covers only the ETL recording interval; activity before recording is not reconstructed.
Image load/rundown proves image presence, not that every export was called. File opens and queries do not imply file content reads.
Only target process metadata is exported. File name associations from other processes are internal context only. No network payload, memory dump, command line or registry values are exported.
Failed and missing file operations require correlated FileIO OperationEnd NTSTATUS events; lack of a completion status is not evidence of success.
FileObject and FileKey are separate identities. Unresolved paths remain explicitly unresolved. Unique rundown backfill is used only when no conflicting key history exists.
PID attribution uses kernel process events plus target-only snapshots; unknown process IDs are excluded rather than guessed.
